macros.name: acr
macros.doc: Displays the short form if the abbreviation identified by ⟨label⟩ has been marked as used, otherwise shows both the long and short form.

macros.name: datagidxconvertchars
macros.doc: Commands such as \& are replaced via \datagidxconvertchars.

macros.name: datagidxdictindent
macros.doc: Indent used by ‘dict’ style.

macros.name: datagidxend
macros.doc: Indicates what to do at the end of the glossary/index.

macros.name: datagidxitem
macros.doc: Indicates what to do at the start of each item of the glossary/index.

macros.name: datagidxlink
macros.doc: If hyperlinks are support, creates a hyperlink with ⟨text⟩ as the link text, otherwise just does ⟨text⟩.

macros.name: datagidxlocalign
macros.doc: Alignment of the location when the location width has been set.

macros.name: datagidxlocationwidth
macros.doc: Space to allocate for the location list.

macros.name: datagidxnewstyle
macros.doc: This defines a new style called ⟨style-name⟩.

macros.name: datagidxstart
macros.doc: Indicates what to do at the start of the glossary/index.

macros.name: datagidxsymbolwidth
macros.doc: Space to allocate for the symbol.

macros.name: datagidxtarget
macros.doc: The name, including the case-changing and font-changing commands, will be encapsulated with \datagidxtarget, which will create a hyper-target, if supported.

macros.name: datagidxwordifygreek
macros.doc: Convert commands like \alpha into words for indexing and labelling purposes.

macros.name: DTLgidxAssignList
macros.doc: Expands to the assignment list used by \DTLgidxForeachEntry, which is internally used by \printterms.

macros.name: DTLgidxCategoryNameFont
macros.doc: Font used for ‘category’ entries with ‘dict’ style.

macros.name: DTLgidxCategorySep
macros.doc: Separator used with ‘dict’ style.

macros.name: DTLgidxChildCountLabel
macros.doc: Label for child counter.

macros.name: DTLgidxChildStyle
macros.doc: Encapsulates the child’s name (including \DTLgidxNameFont and \DTLgidxNameCase) and post-name hook (\DTLgidxPostChildName).

macros.name: DTLgidxCounter
macros.doc: The counter used for the location lists.

macros.name: DTLgidxCurrentdb
macros.doc: This will expand to the database’s name (as identified by database).

macros.name: DTLgidxDictHead
macros.doc: Group header for dict style.

macros.name: DTLgidxDictPostItem
macros.doc: What to do at the end of each item in the ‘dict’ style.

macros.name: DTLgidxEnableHyper
macros.doc: Enables hyperlinks, if supported.

macros.name: DTLgidxEndItem
macros.doc: Inserted at the end of each item (after the location list, child list and cross-references, if applicable).

macros.name: DTLgidxFetchEntry
macros.doc: Fetch value for the given field for the term identified by ⟨label⟩ and store the value in ⟨cs⟩ (a control sequence).

macros.name: DTLgidxForeachEntry
macros.doc: Iterate through the current database, but only do ⟨body⟩ if there is a location or crossreference.

macros.name: DTLgidxFormatDesc
macros.doc: How to format the description.

macros.name: DTLgidxFormatSee
macros.doc: Used to format the “see” cross-reference list.

macros.name: DTLgidxFormatSeeAlso
macros.doc: Used to format the “see also” cross-reference list.

macros.name: DTLgidxGobble
macros.doc: This simply expands to nothing (equivalent to \@gobble).

macros.name: DTLgidxGroupHeaderTitle
macros.doc: Produce the group title from the group label.

macros.name: DTLgidxIgnore
macros.doc: Show argument in document text, but disregard in the sort and label.

macros.name: DTLgidxMac
macros.doc: In the document, just does ⟨text⟩, but gets converted to “Mac” in the sort key.

macros.name: DTLgidxName
macros.doc: How to format a person’s name in the text.

macros.name: DTLgidxNameCase
macros.doc: Used to apply the appropriate case change to the name.

macros.name: DTLgidxNameFont
macros.doc: The font to use for the name in the index/glossary.

macros.name: DTLgidxNameNum
macros.doc: This normally expands to the uppercase Roman numeral of the given number, but will expand to ⟨num⟩ zero-padded to two digits when creating the default sort value.

macros.name: DTLgidxNoFormat
macros.doc: Used by \newterm when creating a label or sort value, simply expands to ⟨text⟩.

macros.name: DTLgidxOffice
macros.doc: Used to markup a person’s office.

macros.name: DTLgidxParticle
macros.doc: Used to markup a surname with a particle.

macros.name: DTLgidxPlace
macros.doc: Used to markup a place.

macros.name: DTLgidxPostChild
macros.doc: What to put at the end of child entries for gloss style.

macros.name: DTLgidxPostChildName
macros.doc: What to put after the child name.

macros.name: DTLgidxPostDescription
macros.doc: What to put after the description.

macros.name: DTLgidxPostLocation
macros.doc: What to put after the location list.

macros.name: DTLgidxPostName
macros.doc: What to put after the name.

macros.name: DTLgidxPreLocation
macros.doc: What to put before the location list.

macros.name: DTLgidxRank
macros.doc: Used to markup a person’s rank.

macros.name: DTLgidxSaint
macros.doc: In the document, just does ⟨text⟩, but gets converted to “Saint” in the sort key.

macros.name: DTLgidxSeeTagFont
macros.doc: Encapsulates the ⟨tag⟩ part in the definition of \DTLgidxFormatSee and \DTLgidxFormatSeeAlso.

macros.name: DTLgidxSetColumns
macros.doc: Locally sets the default number of columns in the index/glossary.

macros.name: DTLgidxSetCompositor
macros.doc: Sets the location compositor.

macros.name: DTLgidxStripBackslash
macros.doc: This expands to the command name without the leading backslash.

macros.name: DTLgidxSubCategorySep
macros.doc: Separator used with ‘dict’ style.

macros.name: DTLgidxSubject
macros.doc: Used to markup a subject.

macros.name: DTLgidxSymDescSep
macros.doc: Separator character between symbol and description if both are present.

macros.name: DTLidxFormatSeeItem
macros.doc: This fetches the corresponding name from the database and, if supported, creates a hyperlink to the referenced label.

macros.name: DTLidxSeeLastSep
macros.doc: Final separator in cross-reference list.

macros.name: DTLidxSeeSep
macros.doc: Separator used in all but final pair of items in cross-reference list.

macros.name: glsadd
macros.doc: Indexes the term identified by ⟨label⟩ without producing any text.

macros.name: glsaddall
macros.doc: Indexes all the terms in the database identified by ⟨db-name⟩ without producing any text.

macros.name: glsdispentry
macros.doc: Displays the value of the given column in the row identified by ⟨label⟩ from the index/glossary database associated with ⟨label⟩ (without indexing or creating a hyperlink).

macros.name: Glsdispentry
macros.doc: This robust command is like \Useentry but it doesn’t index or create a hyperlink.

macros.name: glslink
macros.doc: This behaves like \useentry but displays the provided text instead of the value of a field.

macros.name: glsnl
macros.doc: Shortcut for \useentrynl{⟨label⟩}{Text}.

macros.name: glspl
macros.doc: Shortcut for \useentry{⟨label⟩}{Plural}.

macros.name: glsplnl
macros.doc: Shortcut for \useentrynl{⟨label⟩}{Plural}.

macros.name: Glsplnl
macros.doc: Shortcut for \Useentrynl{⟨label⟩}{Plural}.

macros.name: glsreset
macros.doc: Resets a term so that it’s marked as not used.

macros.name: glsresetall
macros.doc: Resets all entries in the given database.

macros.name: glssym
macros.doc: Shortcut for \useentry{⟨label⟩}{Symbol}.

macros.name: Glssym
macros.doc: This is equivalent to \Useentry{⟨label⟩}{Symbol}.

macros.name: glsunset
macros.doc: Unsets a term so that it’s marked as used.

macros.name: glsunsetall
macros.doc: Unsets all terms in the given database.

macros.name: ifentryused
macros.doc: This is a robust command that does ⟨true⟩ if term identified by the given ⟨label⟩ has been marked as used.

macros.name: iftermexists
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if a term has been defined with the given label, otherwise expands to ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: loadgidx
macros.doc: Loads a datagidx database.

macros.name: loadgidx
macros.doc: Loads a datagidx database.

macros.name: newacro
macros.doc: Shortcut command for acronyms.

macros.name: newacro
macros.doc: Shortcut command for acronyms.

macros.name: newgidx
macros.doc: This creates a new database called ⟨db-name⟩, which has an associated title (⟨title⟩) for use with \printterms.

macros.name: newgidx
macros.doc: This creates a new database called ⟨db-name⟩, which has an associated title (⟨title⟩) for use with \printterms.

macros.name: newterm
macros.doc: This defines a term with the given ⟨name⟩, which is the text to display in the list typeset with \printterms.

macros.name: newterm
macros.doc: This defines a term with the given ⟨name⟩, which is the text to display in the list typeset with \printterms.

arg.snippet: newtermaddfield[${1:db list}]{${2:column key}}[${3:placeholder cs}]{${4:new term key}}[${5:data type}]{${6:default value}}

macros.name: newtermsorthook
macros.doc: Hook used to provide local redefinitions to adjust the sort.

macros.name: printtermsrestoreonecolumn
macros.doc: This is simply defined to do \onecolumn.

macros.name: useentry
macros.doc: Fetch and use the given field for the given entry.

macros.name: Useentry
macros.doc: As \useentry, but capitalise the first word.

macros.name: USEentry
macros.doc: As \useentry, but make the whole term upper case.

macros.name: useentrynl
macros.doc: As \useentry but with no hyperlink.

macros.name: USEentrynl
macros.doc: This is as \USEentry but with no hyperlink.
